notes:
Exporting an edit now checks there is room for it first.

The last release added a space check before an upscale, but the editor's own Export — which upscales a whole timeline and is the longest job Crisp runs — was not covered by it. It is now, and it measures the parts of your clips you actually kept rather than the whole files, so a trimmed edit is never turned away for space it was never going to use.
